note: The promoted affine-4/group-64 precision-island proposal head and its affine-2 compact draft readout are preserved tensor-for-tensor and pinned by digest. Candidate code uses the affine-2 readout only as a retrieval index. At load time the candidate derives a deterministic two-level index from the pinned tensors alone: it dequantizes the affine-4 compact matrix, partitions the 98,336 compact rows by bisection into 12,292 leaves of 8 rows, and quantizes the leaf means to affine-2/group-64 centroids. The per-leaf weight, scale and bias tensors are a permutation of the pinned affine-2 readout, and the six padding rows map back to the real ids they duplicate. Each draft scores the 12,292 centroids, orders the best 3,073 leaves with qwen_mtp_probe_sort, scores the 24,584 rows those leaves own through a gather over the same pinned affine-2 tensors, and reduces them to a 32-row shortlist with qwen_mtp_row_top32_partial and qwen_mtp_row_top32_finalize. If no index is available, the dense fallback scores the full compact readout and shortlists it with qwen_mtp_draft_top32_partial and qwen_mtp_draft_top32_finalize. A single qwen_mtp_draft_selected_affine4_rerank_g64_v1 dispatch then scores exactly those 32 selected rows against the pinned affine-4/group-64 compact matrix, rounds each score to BF16 as the qmv_fast output path does, applies the incumbent total order on (value, id), and maps the winning compact id in the same dispatch. This replaces the prior rerank-stage gather_qmm plus separate value and id reducer, and it does not change shortlist identity or order. The target forward pass, exact target top-2, emitted-token decision, cache journal, rollback, and trusted serial replay are unchanged. The artifact remains immutable-revision and pinned to the runner's single-file model.safetensors tree digest; no remote code is executed and no external index data is read.
